subject: credit of available
bytes: credit raises total only; the second word is the order hold, and only try_hold raises it

subject: notional on debit
reference lead: u128 notional*new/old, floor, min u64::MAX; integer path
bytes: f64: trunc(f64(n)*(f64(new)/f64(old))); n at or above 0x28f5c28f5c28f5c stays unchanged

subject: zero notional on debit
bytes: the remaining balance is valued with the call's price and stored
case: debit t 1000 a 1 n 0 p 777777 h 0

subject: notional on credit
bytes: adds the value of the amount, or of the whole new balance when notional was 0; an overflowing add is dropped

subject: gate
bytes: a price word; price 0 or token 0 skips the notional step, the price is not a bool
case: debit t 1000 a 999 n 1000 p 0 h 0

subject: user index
bytes: only a credit or a hold release indexes the token; a debit or try_hold on a fresh row does not

subject: sweep
bytes: the row is deleted from the user tree, so hold and notional go with it; the index row stays

subject: sweep of an empty set
bytes: the sentinel still gets a credit of 0, which creates its row and index entry
